data.name: VIFA
data.detailed_description:
Skill Progression & Professions — Hardcore Survival Crafting

Gather resources, grow crops, hunt, craft, cook, forge weapons…
Every action shapes your path to survival.

Begin your journey by choosing from several hero-style characters, each equipped with unique talents and skill advantages.
Your choice dramatically changes your pacing, strategy, and challenges—
making every playthrough fresh, varied, and full of new survival possibilities.

Mini-Worker System

Command a squad of Mini-Workers—
each powered by advanced AI logic capable of precise gathering and production tasks.

Design and deploy them. Assign roles, manage energy grids, optimize production lines,
and build a base that can run almost entirely on its own.
From a primitive camp to a fully automated machine ecosystem—
every workflow and every decision reflects your strategic mind.
In this world, the strength of your base equals the sharpness of your command.

Buildable Combat Mechs

Craft, assemble, and pilot your own VIFA combat mech—
your most trusted partner in the wasteland.

Let its AI take over while you mine and gather;
it will stand guard and keep you safe.
Customize it into a transport rig, a battle machine, or an explorer frame—
cargo bays, weapons, scanners… mix and match freely.

Finish it with custom parts and paintwork to forge a mech that is truly your own.

Base Building & Self-Sufficiency

Build your fortress from the ground up:
farms, water sources, power systems, defense towers, storage warehouses, and more.

Manage water, food, energy, and materials as you face wilderness threats
and fend off attacks from other mechs.
Create a home that can truly survive the wasteland.

After Ragnarok — A Fallen Empire

After the great Ragnarok, the Odin Empire lies in ruins.
You will explore shattered cities destroyed by the Loki Core,
wastelands patrolled by alien war-machines,
and wilderness where energy-born creatures are awakening once more.

Recover lost energy, technology, and mech fragments
to piece together the truth behind the empire’s collapse
while strengthening yourself and your base.

Your final goal — rebuild your strength and strike back
against the traitorous AI: Loki.

data.short_description: Vifa is a survival-building game where each hero character brings unique talents that change how you play. Team up with friends, craft and build your base, deploy worker bots to gather resources, and assemble powerful mechs to defend your home.
data.supported_languages: English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Simplified Chinese

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 970 4GB / AMD RX 580 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 MB available space
